arStrings.szText: Hitting at least one enemy with {c_important}Rake{/c} reduces your longest active Cooldown by {c_number}[{SF_14}|1|]{/c} seconds.

For each stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} you have, {c_important}Rake's{/c} Vigor cost is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_15}]{/c} and its initial hit's damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Rake{/c} manifests a spirit Jaguar which rakes a random enemy dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_A}{/c} damage before exploding for {c_number}{payload:EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_A}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Rake{/c} is {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|%|]{/c} larger. {c_important}Rake's{/c} initial hit pulls in enemies at its edge and hits enemies again for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_B}{/c} damage. 

If {c_important}Rake{/c} only hits a single target, it deals {c_number}[SF_31*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

{c_important}Rake{/c} becomes a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill that deals Physical damage. 

{c_important}Rake{/c} sweeps in front of you, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_C}{/c} damage and gaining a stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} if you hit an enemy.
